behaviors.description: Observe OSTree diagnostics from an installed commit query.

behaviors.expected: OSTree verbosity adds stderr diagnostics while stdout, commits and remotes remain unchanged between quiet controls.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes during installed-ref enumeration.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A app/runtime installed in isolated state.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes on an already-current update.
behaviors.preconditions: Exact independently prepared current app/runtime commits.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes on a repeated or-update install.
behaviors.preconditions: Exact independently prepared current app/runtime commits.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes on app removal.
behaviors.preconditions: App A is restored before each quiet or diagnostic invocation.
behaviors.expected: Each invocation removes only the app and retains the runtime; verbosity adds diagnostics while ordinary output remains equal.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes during duplicate remote-add.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A installation and an existing sentinel remote.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes while setting a remote title.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A installation and an existing fixed-title remote.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes during deletion of an unused remote.
behaviors.preconditions: An extra unused remote is restored before every invocation; the fixture remote remains installed.
behaviors.expected: Only the extra remote disappears; verbosity adds diagnostics while stdout, fixture remote and installed commits remain unchanged.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes while selecting the installed app branch.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A app/runtime installed in isolated state.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe both verbosity modes during a healthy repair dry run.
behaviors.preconditions: Healthy independently prepared A app/runtime installation.
behaviors.expected: Each verbosity mode adds diagnostics without changing stdout or public installation state; quiet controls match.

behaviors.description: Observe OSTree diagnostics while inspecting an independent repository.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A repository and isolated installed app/runtime controls.
behaviors.expected: OSTree verbosity adds diagnostics while repository info stdout and installed state remain unchanged between quiet controls.
